rules.rationale: This k-cell rule implements the iterator observation for the empty symbolic integer-list representation by producing #iterDone; it is execution behavior in the verification model, not an additional mathematical fact.
This k-cell rule implements one iterator step for a nonempty symbolic integer list, yielding its head and residual iterator; it is ordinary operational behavior of the verification model.
This is the first equation of the named contribution summary, defining the square contribution when the index is divisible by three.
This is the second piecewise equation of contribution, defining the cube case when divisibility by four holds and the earlier divisibility-by-three case does not.
This is the final piecewise equation of contribution, defining the unchanged-value case when neither earlier branch applies.
This equation defines the base case of the tail-recursive sumSquares mathematical summary: an empty remainder returns the accumulator.
This recurrence defines sumSquares on a nonempty integer sequence by advancing the index and adding the head's defined contribution.
This equation defines the empty-sequence base case of the endIndex structural summary.
This recurrence defines endIndex for a nonempty remainder by consuming one element and incrementing the index.
This equation defines the empty-sequence base case of endValue, preserving the previously bound value.
This recurrence defines endValue on a nonempty remainder by carrying the current head forward as the most recently bound value.
This macro-expansion rule defines the named proof term sumSquaresLoopBody as the exact translated loop-body statement sequence.
This macro-expansion rule defines the named proof term sumSquaresFunctionBody as the initialization, loop, and return statement sequence.
